Gordon Ryan - My Evolution Your Revoluti.overview: Gordon Ryan's breakdown of his ADCC 2024 superfight performances (against Felipe Pena and Yuri Simões), eight volumes. Volumes 1 to 3 cover the Felipe Pena match: mindset, 'camping' inside the guard, dealing with Felipe's guard recovery, a calf slicer entry, and managing an injury and pacing. Volumes 4 to 7 cover Yuri Simões: passing tactics and camping, solidifying near-side and double underhooks, opening the closed guard, half guard, and being flattened in half guard / side guard. Volume 8 is full match commentary for both.
Gordon Ryan - My Evolution Your Revoluti.for: Students of Gordon's newer 'inside camping' passing style and match strategy.

Gordon Ryan - Systematically Attacking t.overview: Gordon Ryan's beginner's guide to standing exchanges (the 'scrimmage') for jiu-jitsu, six parts. Part 1 covers goals, wrestling versus jiu-jitsu, time limits and pacing, posture, scoring, submission risks and the centreline-versus-back dilemma. Part 2 covers stance and motion (line of sight, head/hands/hips, same versus opposite stance, distance and the three zones). Part 3 covers gripping (inside position wins, clearing collar ties, exposing the centreline and the back). Part 4 covers defending shots (early versus late defence, defending singles and doubles). Parts 5 and 6 are rolls and rolling commentary. It's the first course in his Scrimmage series; the publisher also sells separate volumes on upper and lower body takedowns and submission offence.
Gordon Ryan - Systematically Attacking t.for: Jiu-jitsu players with little wrestling who want a safe, simple standing game.
